components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--approval); color: #f8f4e9; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 760; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #244b3c; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(36,75,60,.18); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(49,92,76,.3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Quiet utility action for session exit.
components.css: .ds-button-text { padding: 7px 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--approval); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-weight: 720; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-text:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-text:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(49,92,76,.24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Large familiar field with precise hover, focus, and error feedback.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 9px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 720; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 54px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 12px; outline: none; background: rgba(255,255,255,.38); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-weight: 400; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #83847c; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--approval); background: rgba(255,255,255,.64); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(49,92,76,.16); }

components.name: Authentication Navigation
components.description: Two familiar links in the editorial header with an ocre active rule.
components.css: .ds-auth-nav { display: flex; gap: 20px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-auth-nav a { position: relative; padding: 6px 0 9px; color: rgba(248,244,233,.8); font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; } .ds-auth-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(248,244,233,.82); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-auth-nav .ds-auth-current { color: var(--paper); } .ds-auth-nav .ds-auth-current::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 8px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--tag); }

components.name: Brand Wordmark
components.description: Warm-white Newsreader wordmark with one controlled ocre detail.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { position: relative; display: inline-block; color: var(--paper); font-family: var(--font-newsreader), serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: -.03em; line-height: 1.15; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark span { display: block; } .ds-wordmark::after { display: block; width: 22px; height: 2px; margin-top: 10px; background: var(--tag); content: ''; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(248,244,233,.82); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Authentication Frame
components.description: Two-area organizing surface for product context and authentication.
components.css: .ds-auth-frame { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(360px,.9fr) minmax(480px,1.1fr); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 26px 80px rgba(37,42,45,.12); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-auth-frame > aside { padding: clamp(32px,4vw,52px); background: var(--approval); color: var(--paper); } .ds-auth-frame > main { padding: clamp(48px,6vw,82px) clamp(40px,6vw,84px); background: var(--paper); }

components.name: Editorial Journey
components.description: Three factual product steps that add useful context without competing with the form.
components.html:
1. 01
    Descoberta

    Busca unificada entre marketplaces.

  2. 02
    Evidência

    Histórico de preço, marca e qualidade.

  3. 03
    Decisão

    Ranking assistido e aprovação humana.
components.css: .ds-journey { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--approval); color: var(--paper); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; list-style: none; } .ds-journey li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px 1fr; gap: 14px; padding: 17px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(248,244,233,.18); } .ds-journey li:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(248,244,233,.18); } .ds-journey li > span { color: rgba(248,244,233,.9); font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; font-size: .72rem; } .ds-journey strong { font-size: .82rem; } .ds-journey p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: rgba(248,244,233,.78); font-size: .76rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Password Reveal
components.description: Compact text action embedded in password fields.
components.css: .ds-password { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-password input { width: 100%; height: 54px; padding: 0 84px 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.38); color: var(--ink); } .ds-password button { position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 9px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--approval); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-size: .76rem; font-weight: 700; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-password button:hover { background: rgba(49,92,76,.08); } .ds-password button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(49,92,76,.24); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
O sistema apresenta curadoria de ofertas como trabalho editorial criterioso: papel quente, tinta escura e um painel verde que explica por que contexto importa. A experiência é calma e operacional. A narrativa orienta; o formulário continua sendo a tarefa principal.

A materialidade vem de fibras raster sutis, variações tonais mínimas, linhas finas e uma única camada de profundidade. Newsreader dá voz à marca e às manchetes. Geist mantém controles, etapas e explicações diretos. A referência é uma publicação de curadoria contemporânea, não uma mesa cenográfica nem um arquivo burocrático.
keyCharacteristics: Papel quente com textura raster de fibras quase imperceptível.
Painel editorial verde como contraponto ao formulário em papel.
Hierarquia serena entre contexto, jornada e tarefa.
Ocre usado como detalhe único de identidade.
Serifado restrito à marca e aos títulos; Geist no restante.

rules.name: The One Ochre Detail Rule
rules.body: Use ocre once per composition as identity punctuation, never as repeated tags or decoration.

rules.name: The Green Carries Context Rule
rules.body: Use green for the editorial panel, action, focus, selection, approval, and concise positive notes.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Newsreader only for brand and titles. Use Geist for every operational or explanatory element; use Geist Mono only for compact sequence numbers.

rules.name: The One Lifted Surface Rule
rules.body: Only the complete authentication frame may float at rest; its two areas remain flat.

dos: Do keep the form as the primary task and the green panel as concise orientation.
Do use warm paper, dark ink, approval green, and one ocre detail as the complete palette hierarchy.
Do describe the product through the implemented journey: descoberta, evidência, and decisão.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and disable nonessential motion for reduced-motion users.
Do retain the editorial headline on mobile while hiding deeper supporting detail.
donts: Don't literalize a desk scene with photos, loose stationery, maps, clips, or props.
Don't restore the former three-column authentication layout or a separate evidence rail.
Don't add approval seals, badges, ornamental stamps, or repeated tags.
Don't use Newsreader for form controls, body copy, journey details, or navigation.
Don't invent marketplace claims beyond the listed sources and implemented product flow.
Don't add shadows to individual areas or controls at rest.
